abort.cannot_connect: Could not authenticate the sensor at its advertised address. Its saved address has not changed.
abort.invalid_discovery: The sensor announcement has no valid device identity. Add the integration manually.
abort.reauth_successful: Pairing renewed. Your existing entities and settings are preserved.
abort.wrong_device: This is a different sensor. Pair the sensor originally configured in this entry.

error.address_auth_failed: The address did not authenticate as the original sensor. Check the address, or renew pairing if its credentials were revoked.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect. Check the address, Wi-Fi connection, and pairing window.
error.invalid_auth: Pairing failed. Check the displayed code and try again.

data_description.code: Enter all eight digits, including any leading zeros.
data_description.host: The sensor must be reachable from Home Assistant over the local network. Do not include a port or URL.

reauth_confirm.description: On the original sensor, open Setup → Home Assistant, disconnect the old pairing, then tap Pair. Enter its current address and new eight-digit code. Keep this integration entry to preserve its entities and settings.
reauth_confirm.title: Renew pairing

data_description.host: The sensor must be reachable from Home Assistant over the local network. Do not include a port or URL.

reconfigure.description: Enter the original sensor’s new address. Its identity and saved certificate will be checked before saving.
reconfigure.title: Change sensor address

data_description.code: Enter all eight digits, including any leading zeros.
data_description.host: The sensor must be reachable from Home Assistant over the local network. Do not include a port or URL.

user.description: On the sensor, open Setup → Home Assistant → Pair. Enter its local address and the eight-digit code shown on its display. The code expires after two minutes.
user.title: Connect your Terrestream

busy.message: The sensor is busy. Allow maintenance to finish, then try again.

cannot_connect.message: The sensor is unavailable. Check its network connection and allow any maintenance to finish.

command_failed.message: The sensor could not apply this setting. Check its connection and try again.

invalid_timezone.message: Enter a valid IANA time zone, such as Europe/London.

minute_precision.message: Enter a time with zero seconds and no time zone. Quiet hours use the sensor’s time zone.

pairing_revoked.message: Pairing is no longer valid. Use the Home Assistant repair notification to renew pairing with the original sensor.

readback_failed.message: The setting was sent, but its current value could not be confirmed. Wait for the sensor to reconnect before retrying.

revision_conflict.message: Settings changed on the sensor before this request was applied. Wait for the controls to refresh, then try again.

storage_failure.message: The sensor could not save the setting. Check its settings-storage repair notification.

preferences_storage.description: The sensor reports a settings-storage error. Allow any firmware update to finish, then restart the sensor once and check whether its settings persist. If the warning remains, contact support@terrestream.com. Avoid a factory reset, which removes the saved configuration.
preferences_storage.title: {name} could not save its settings
